title: EMA v1.1 Next Steps Bootstrap Database
description: Primary bootstrap corpus for EMA v1.1 daemon/backbone/backend planning, convergence, and recovery.
truth_boundaries: This folder is the bootstrap corpus for planning, reconciliation, architecture, recovery, and handoff context.
This folder is not the live operational store; runtime writes remain in ~/.local/share/ema/ema.db.
This folder does not override active code truth in ~/Projects/ema.
This folder must preserve plane separation across canon, planning, runtime, gaps, handoffs, and imports.

planes.04-CANON: canon extracts, trust rules, target-shape notes

indexing_rules: Ingest this folder before broader archival or import datasets.
Preserve file path, frontmatter id, and layer/type metadata as provenance keys.
Create graph links across related plans, decisions, gaps, and runtime notes instead of flattening them.
Write back new material into the correct plane rather than appending to unrelated documents.
